basedOn: Adapted from Arthur Conan Doyle's A Study in Scarlet (1887) and The Red-Headed League (1891).
chapterTitle: 第一章 · 贝克街的房客

vocabBank.en: Stamford! Yes, I just came back from Afghanistan.
vocabBank.zh: 斯坦福！是的，我刚从阿富汗回来。

vocabBank.en: A bullet hit my shoulder, so they sent me home.
vocabBank.zh: 一颗子弹打中我肩膀，所以他们把我送回国了。

vocabBank.en: Nothing yet. I'm looking for cheap rooms.
vocabBank.zh: 还没着落。我在找便宜的住处。

vocabBank.en: Really? Who was the first?
How do you do, Mr. Holmes?
How on earth did you know that?
No, I don't. I smoke myself.
All right, I'll be there at noon.
Yes, that's me. I met him yesterday.
vocabBank.zh: 是的，就是我。我昨天见过他。

vocabBank.en: Very nice. Can I see the bedrooms?
vocabBank.zh: 很不错。我能看看卧室吗？

vocabBank.en: How much is it a month?
Not at all. I'll enjoy the music.
vocabBank.zh: 完全没有，我会很享受的。

vocabBank.en: Let's do it. I'll bring my things tomorrow.
vocabBank.zh: 就这么定。我明天把东西搬过来。

vocabBank.en: Sorry, am I interrupting?
vocabBank.zh: 抱歉，我打扰到你们了吗？

vocabBank.en: Please go on, Mr. Wilson.
I see. What is he like?
Half pay? That's very unusual.
vocabBank.zh: 一半工钱？这可太少见了。

vocabBank.en: Can I take a look?
And did they choose you?
You were lucky. What was the work?
That sounds easy. So they paid you every week?
vocabBank.zh: 听起来很轻松。所以他们每周都给你钱？

vocabBank.en: What does it say?
That's very strange. Did you look for Mr. Ross?
vocabBank.zh: 太奇怪了。你去找罗斯先生了吗？

vocabBank.en: You're in good hands, Mr. Wilson.
vocabBank.zh: 威尔逊先生，你找对人了。

vocabBank.en: No, I don't. Not at all.
All right. I'll read the paper quietly.
Why are you hitting the ground with your stick?
vocabBank.zh: 你为什么用手杖敲地面？

vocabBank.en: Good idea. Let's ask him.
Thank you, that's very kind.
I didn't notice. What does it mean?
Of course. When do we start?
vocabBank.zh: 当然。我们什么时候开始？

vocabBank.en: I'll bring it. Is it dangerous?
Who is he? Do you know him?
All right. Please knock on my door at half past nine.
Pleased to meet you. Are we going there now?
vocabBank.zh: 幸会。我们现在就去那儿吗？

vocabBank.en: Gold! Now I understand.
Understood. How long do we wait?
I'm ready. My revolver is in my hand.
vocabBank.zh: 我准备好了。手枪就在我手里。

vocabBank.en: Well done! We caught him.
I see. He took the job because he wanted the shop.
vocabBank.zh: 我明白了。他接这份活，是因为他想要那家店。

vocabBank.en: So you tapped the ground to find the tunnel.
vocabBank.zh: 所以你敲地面是为了找那条地道。

vocabBank.en: Amazing. How did you know it was tonight?
vocabBank.zh: 太厉害了。你怎么知道是今晚？

vocabBank.en: Sleep well, Holmes. And thank you.
vocabBank.zh: 好好睡一觉，福尔摩斯。谢谢你。

vocabBank.en: A crown? Who is it from?
Pawnshop.
Advertisement.
Encyclopaedia.
Cellar.
Tunnel.
Revolver.

transition.en: London, 1881. You are Dr. John Watson, an army doctor just home from the war in Afghanistan. You have little money and no friends in the city.
transition.zh: 1881 年，伦敦。你是约翰·华生医生，刚从阿富汗战场退伍回国的军医。手头没什么钱，城里也没有朋友。

scenes.title: An Old Friend
scenes.subtitle: 伦敦 · 酒吧偶遇 · 退伍归来

npcLine.en: Watson? Is that you? Good heavens, you're as thin as a stick!
npcLine.zh: 华生？是你吗？天哪，你瘦得像根棍子！

choices.text: Stamford! Yes, I just came back from Afghanistan.
choices.zh: 斯坦福！是的，我刚从阿富汗回来。

choices.text: Sorry, I don't know you.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用一般过去时说自己刚做的事 → I just came back from Afghanistan.

npcLine.en: Afghanistan! What happened to you out there?
npcLine.zh: 阿富汗！你在那边出什么事了？

choices.text: A bullet hit my shoulder, so they sent me home.
choices.zh: 一颗子弹打中我肩膀，所以他们把我送回国了。

choices.text: A bullet hit my shoulder, so they send me home.

n2.hintOnWrong: 过去的事用过去时，so 连出结果 → A bullet hit my shoulder, so they sent me home.

npcLine.en: Poor fellow. And what are you doing now?
npcLine.zh: 可怜的家伙。那你现在在做什么？

choices.text: Nothing yet. I'm looking for cheap rooms.
choices.zh: 还没着落。我在找便宜的住处。

choices.text: I'm the King of England.

n3.hintOnWrong: 正在做的事用现在进行时 → I'm looking for cheap rooms.

npcLine.en: That's funny. You're the second man today who said that to me.
npcLine.zh: 有意思。你是今天第二个跟我这么说的人。

choices.text: Really? Who was the first?
choices.zh: 真的？第一个是谁？

choices.text: Really? Who is the first?

n4.hintOnWrong: 用 Who 追问是谁 → Who was the first?

transition.en: The first man, Stamford says, is called Sherlock Holmes. The next morning, he takes you to the chemistry laboratory at St Bartholomew's Hospital. A tall, thin man is bent over a test tube.
transition.zh: 斯坦福说，第一个人叫夏洛克·福尔摩斯。第二天上午，他带你去圣巴塞洛缪医院的化学实验室。一个又高又瘦的男人正俯身盯着一支试管。

scenes.title: The Laboratory
scenes.subtitle: 圣巴塞洛缪医院 · 化学实验室

npcLine.en: Here he is. Holmes, this is my friend Dr. Watson.
npcLine.zh: 他在这儿。福尔摩斯，这是我朋友华生医生。

choices.text: How do you do, Mr. Holmes?
choices.zh: 您好，福尔摩斯先生。

choices.text: Where is the doctor?

n1.hintOnWrong: 初次见面的正式问候 → How do you do, Mr. Holmes?

npcLine.en: You've been in Afghanistan, I see.
npcLine.zh: 你去过阿富汗吧，我看得出来。

choices.text: How on earth did you know that?
choices.zh: 你到底是怎么知道的？

choices.text: No, I live in London.

n2.hintOnWrong: 惊讶地追问对方怎么知道 → How on earth did you know that?

npcLine.en: Never mind that now. Stamford says you want rooms. So do I. Do you mind the smell of strong tobacco?
npcLine.zh: 这个先不说。斯坦福说你想找房子，我也是。你介意浓烈的烟草味吗？

choices.text: No, I don't. I smoke myself.
choices.zh: 不介意，我自己也抽烟。

choices.text: Yes, please, two sugars.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 No, I don't 简短回答 → No, I don't. I smoke myself.

npcLine.en: Good. I have my eye on some rooms in Baker Street. Come and see them tomorrow at noon.
npcLine.zh: 很好。我看中了贝克街的几间房。明天中午来看看吧。

choices.text: All right, I'll be there at noon.
choices.zh: 好，我中午到。

choices.text: I was there yesterday.

n4.hintOnWrong: 答应将来要做的事用 I'll → I'll be there at noon.

transition.en: Noon, the next day. A tall house on Baker Street. An older lady opens the door.
transition.zh: 第二天中午，贝克街上一栋高高的房子。一位上了年纪的女士来开门。

scenes.title: 221B Baker Street
scenes.subtitle: 贝克街 221B · 看房

npcLine.en: Good afternoon. You must be Dr. Watson. Mr. Holmes is upstairs.
npcLine.zh: 下午好。您一定是华生医生吧。福尔摩斯先生在楼上。

choices.text: Yes, that's me. I met him yesterday.
choices.zh: 是的，就是我。我昨天见过他。

choices.text: No, I'm Mr. Holmes.

n1.hintOnWrong: 确认身份，并用过去时说昨天的事 → I met him yesterday.

npcLine.en: Watson! Two bedrooms, one sitting room, two big windows. What do you think?
npcLine.zh: 华生！两间卧室，一间起居室，两扇大窗。你觉得怎么样？

choices.text: Very nice. Can I see the bedrooms?
choices.zh: 很不错。我能看看卧室吗？

choices.text: I don't like windows.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 Can I 提出请求 → Can I see the bedrooms?

npcLine.en: Of course. And the rent is quite low, if we share it.
npcLine.zh: 当然。房租也不贵，如果我们分摊的话。

choices.text: How much is it a month?
choices.zh: 一个月多少钱？

choices.text: How old is the house?

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 How much 问价格 → How much is it a month?

npcLine.en: Eight pounds, four each. Now, my habits. I play the violin at night. Is that a problem?
npcLine.zh: 八镑，一人四镑。再说说我的习惯。我晚上拉小提琴，有问题吗？

choices.text: Not at all. I'll enjoy the music.
choices.zh: 完全没有，我会很享受的。

choices.text: Yes, I play the drums.

n4.hintOnWrong: 表示不介意，用 I'll 说自己会怎样 → Not at all. I'll enjoy the music.

npcLine.en: Excellent. Then let's take the rooms.
npcLine.zh: 太好了。那我们就把房子定下来吧。

choices.text: Let's do it. I'll bring my things tomorrow.
choices.zh: 就这么定。我明天把东西搬过来。

choices.text: Let's do it. I'll bringing my things tomorrow.

n5.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's do it. I'll bring my things tomorrow.

transition.en: Some weeks later. You come home and find a stout man with fiery red hair sitting in your sitting room.
transition.zh: 几周后。你回到家，发现起居室里坐着一个顶着一头火红头发的胖男人。

scenes.title: A Red-Headed Visitor
scenes.subtitle: 贝克街 · 一位红发客人

npcLine.en: Watson, come in! Mr. Wilson here is telling me a very strange story.
npcLine.zh: 华生，进来！这位威尔逊先生正在给我讲一个非常奇怪的故事。

choices.text: Sorry, am I interrupting?
choices.zh: 抱歉，我打扰到你们了吗？

choices.text: I'm going out again.

n1.hintOnWrong: 问自己是不是正在打扰 → Sorry, am I interrupting?

npcLine.en: Not at all. Sit down. Mr. Wilson, please tell my friend everything from the beginning.
npcLine.zh: 完全没有。坐。威尔逊先生，请从头把一切讲给我朋友听。

choices.text: Please go on, Mr. Wilson.
choices.zh: 请继续，威尔逊先生。

choices.text: Please leave, Mr. Wilson.

n2.hintOnWrong: 礼貌请对方继续说 → Please go on, Mr. Wilson.

npcLine.en: I keep a small pawnshop in Saxe-Coburg Square. Business is slow, so I have only one assistant.
npcLine.zh: 我在萨克斯-科伯格广场开一家小当铺。生意清淡，所以只雇了一个伙计。

choices.text: I see. What is he like?
choices.zh: 明白。他这人怎么样？

choices.text: I want to buy a shop.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 What is he like 问对方是个怎样的人 → What is he like?

npcLine.en: Spaulding? A clever young man. He works for half pay, because he wants to learn the trade.
npcLine.zh: 斯波尔丁？很机灵的年轻人。他只拿一半工钱，因为他想学这门手艺。

choices.text: Half pay? That's very unusual.
choices.zh: 一半工钱？这可太少见了。

choices.text: I work for free too.

n4.hintOnWrong: 用陈述句表达看法 → That's very unusual.

npcLine.en: That's what I thought. Then, two months ago, he showed me this advertisement in the newspaper.
npcLine.zh: 我也是这么想的。后来，两个月前，他给我看了报纸上的这则广告。

choices.text: Can I take a look?
choices.zh: 我能看一眼吗？

choices.text: I can't read.

n5.hintOnWrong: 用 Can I 请求看一下 → Can I take a look?

scenes.title: Four Pounds a Week
scenes.subtitle: 红发会 · 一份奇怪的差事

npcLine.en: 'To the Red-Headed League: a position for a red-headed man, four pounds a week, easy work.' So I went to the office with Spaulding.
npcLine.zh: 「致红发会：招一名红发男子，周薪四镑，工作轻松。」于是我和斯波尔丁去了办公室。

choices.text: And did they choose you?
choices.zh: 那他们选中你了吗？

choices.text: Did you buy a hat?

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 Did they 问过去发生的事 → And did they choose you?

npcLine.en: They did! Hundreds of red-headed men waited outside, but the manager, Mr. Duncan Ross, picked me.
npcLine.zh: 选中了！几百个红发男人在外面排队，但经理邓肯·罗斯先生选了我。

choices.text: You were lucky. What was the work?
choices.zh: 你真走运。工作是什么？

choices.text: You were lucky. What is the work?

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 was / were 谈过去的事 → You were lucky. What was the work?

npcLine.en: Copying the Encyclopaedia Britannica. Every day from ten until two, in a small office. I copied the letter A for eight weeks.
npcLine.zh: 抄《大英百科全书》。每天上午十点到下午两点，在一间小办公室里。我抄了八个星期的字母 A。

choices.text: That sounds easy. So they paid you every week?
choices.zh: 听起来很轻松。所以他们每周都给你钱？

choices.text: That sounds easy. So they pay you every week?

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 so 接着往下推 → So they paid you every week?

npcLine.en: Every Saturday, four gold pounds. Then, this morning, I found this on the office door.
npcLine.zh: 每周六，四个金镑。然后，今天早上，我在办公室门上发现了这个。

choices.text: What does it say?
choices.zh: 上面写了什么？

choices.text: Is it lunch time?

n4.hintOnWrong: 问纸上写了什么 → What does it say?

scenes.title: The League Is Dissolved
scenes.subtitle: 贝克街 · 红发会解散了

npcLine.en: 'THE RED-HEADED LEAGUE IS DISSOLVED. October the ninth.' No office, no Mr. Ross, no money. Everyone is gone!
npcLine.zh: 「红发会已解散。10 月 9 日。」办公室没了，罗斯先生没了，钱也没了。人全都不见了！

choices.text: That's very strange. Did you look for Mr. Ross?
choices.zh: 太奇怪了。你去找罗斯先生了吗？

choices.text: That's very strange. Did you looked for Mr. Ross?

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 Did you 问对方有没有做 → Did you look for Mr. Ross?

npcLine.en: I did. The landlord never heard of him. So I came straight to Mr. Holmes.
npcLine.zh: 找了。房东根本没听说过这个人。所以我直接来找福尔摩斯先生了。

choices.text: You're in good hands, Mr. Wilson.
choices.zh: 威尔逊先生，你找对人了。

choices.text: You're in trouble, Mr. Wilson.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用陈述句安慰对方 → You're in good hands, Mr. Wilson.

npcLine.en: Mr. Wilson, you lost nothing. You gained thirty pounds, and you know the letter A very well now. Watson, do you understand it?
npcLine.zh: 威尔逊先生，你什么都没损失。你赚了三十镑，还把字母 A 学了个透。华生，你看明白了吗？

choices.text: No, I don't. Not at all.
choices.zh: 没有，完全没看明白。

choices.text: Yes, I made it myself.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 No, I don't 简短回答 → No, I don't. Not at all.

npcLine.en: Neither do I, not yet. It's a three-pipe problem. Please don't speak to me for fifty minutes.
npcLine.zh: 我也没有，暂时还没。这是个三斗烟的问题。五十分钟内请别跟我说话。

choices.text: All right. I'll read the paper quietly.
choices.zh: 好，我安静地看报。

choices.text: Let's talk for an hour.

n4.hintOnWrong: 答应对方，用 I'll 说自己接下来做什么 → I'll read the paper quietly.

transition.en: That afternoon, Holmes takes you to Mr. Wilson's street. He stops in front of the pawnshop and taps the pavement with his walking stick.
transition.zh: 当天下午，福尔摩斯带你去威尔逊先生的那条街。他在当铺门前停下，用手杖敲了敲人行道。

scenes.title: Tapping the Pavement
scenes.subtitle: 萨克斯-科伯格广场 · 当铺门口

npcLine.en: Here's the pawnshop. Now watch this.
npcLine.zh: 当铺就是这家。看好了。

choices.text: Why are you hitting the ground with your stick?
choices.zh: 你为什么用手杖敲地面？

choices.text: Why do you hitting the ground with your stick?

n1.hintOnWrong: 问对方正在做什么 → Why are you hitting the ground with your stick?

npcLine.en: I'm listening to the ground. Now let's knock and ask the assistant the way to the Strand.
npcLine.zh: 我在听地下的动静。现在我们去敲门，向那个伙计问去斯特兰德街怎么走。

choices.text: Good idea. Let's ask him.
choices.zh: 好主意。我们去问他。

choices.text: Let's go home.

n2.hintOnWrong: 同意提议 → Good idea. Let's ask him.

npcLine.en: The Strand? Third right, fourth left, sir.
npcLine.zh: 斯特兰德街？第三个路口右转，第四个路口左转，先生。

choices.text: Thank you, that's very kind.
choices.zh: 谢谢，您真好。

choices.text: No, thank you.

n3.hintOnWrong: 道谢 → Thank you, that's very kind.

npcLine.en: Did you see his trousers, Watson? The knees were worn and dirty.
npcLine.zh: 华生，你看见他的裤子了吗？膝盖那儿磨破了，脏兮兮的。

choices.text: I didn't notice. What does it mean?
choices.zh: 我没注意。这说明什么？

choices.text: He needs new shoes.

n4.hintOnWrong: 用 didn't 说自己没注意到，再追问 → I didn't notice. What does it mean?

transition.en: After a concert, Holmes is silent for a long time. Then he finally speaks.
transition.zh: 音乐会结束后，福尔摩斯沉默了很久。然后他终于开口。

scenes.title: Bring Your Revolver
scenes.subtitle: 音乐会之后 · 今晚有行动

npcLine.en: Watson, a serious crime is planned for tonight. I need your help. Are you free?
npcLine.zh: 华生，今晚有人要犯一桩大案。我需要你帮忙。你有空吗？

choices.text: Of course. When do we start?
choices.zh: 当然。我们什么时候开始？

choices.text: Of course. When we do start?

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 When 问时间 → When do we start?

npcLine.en: Ten o'clock, back at Baker Street. Two other men will join us. And please bring your army revolver.
npcLine.zh: 十点，回贝克街。还有两个人会来。另外，请带上你的军用左轮手枪。

choices.text: I'll bring it. Is it dangerous?
choices.zh: 我会带的。危险吗？

choices.text: I'll bring my violin.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 I'll 答应，再确认 → I'll bring it. Is it dangerous?

npcLine.en: Possibly. The man we want is John Clay. A thief, and a very clever one.
npcLine.zh: 有可能。我们要抓的人叫约翰·克莱。一个贼，而且非常狡猾。

choices.text: Who is he? Do you know him?
choices.zh: 他是谁？你认识他？

choices.text: Is he a doctor?

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 Do you 问对方认不认识 → Do you know him?

npcLine.en: I know of him. He's the pawnshop assistant. Now go and rest. It'll be a long night.
npcLine.zh: 我听说过他。他就是当铺那个伙计。现在去休息吧。今晚会很长。

choices.text: All right. Please knock on my door at half past nine.
choices.zh: 好。请九点半敲我的门。

choices.text: All right. Please knocking on my door at half past nine.

n4.hintOnWrong: 用 Please 提出请求 → Please knock on my door at half past nine.

transition.en: Ten o'clock. Two men are waiting at Baker Street: a police inspector and a bank director. A cab takes you all across the city to the bank.
transition.zh: 十点。贝克街上等着两个人：一位警探和一位银行经理。一辆马车载着你们穿过城市，来到银行。

scenes.title: The Bank Cellar
scenes.subtitle: 城市银行地下室 · 守夜

npcLine.en: Dr. Watson? Merryweather, director of the City Bank. Our cellar is right behind that pawnshop, you know.
npcLine.zh: 华生医生？我是梅里韦瑟，城市银行的经理。我们的地下室就在那家当铺后面。

choices.text: Pleased to meet you. Are we going there now?
choices.zh: 幸会。我们现在就去那儿吗？

choices.text: Pleased to meet you. Are we go there now?

n1.hintOnWrong: 问接下来是不是要去 → Are we going there now?

npcLine.en: Down these stairs, gentlemen. Mind the boxes. They hold two thousand gold coins from the Bank of France.
npcLine.zh: 各位，走这边楼梯下去。小心那些箱子。里面是法兰西银行的两千枚金币。

choices.text: Gold! Now I understand.
choices.zh: 金子！现在我明白了。

choices.text: Gold! Can I take some?

n2.hintOnWrong: 用陈述句说自己明白了 → Gold! Now I understand.

npcLine.en: Quiet now. Put out the lantern and wait in the dark. Not a sound.
npcLine.zh: 现在安静。灭掉提灯，在黑暗里等着。别出声。

choices.text: Understood. How long do we wait?

scenes.subtitle: 圣约翰伍德 · 乔装打探
